cv.name: Owen Carrington
cv.headline: VP Engineering | Fintech platforms | Building teams of 60+ engineers
cv.summary: Engineering leader with seventeen years in software, the last eight running engineering organisations in health tech and fintech. I care about reliable platforms, sensible architecture and managers who grow their people.

experience.title: VP Engineering
bullets: Lead 64 engineers across payments, ledger and platform teams, reporting to the CEO
Moved core ledger services from a monolith to event-driven services on AWS without customer downtime
Introduced an on-call and incident review process; P1 incidents down 45% year on year
Own a £7.5M engineering budget and the hiring plan
Work with compliance on FCA operational resilience requirements

experience.title: Head of Engineering
bullets: Grew the team from 12 to 38 engineers and set up the engineering manager track
Delivered NHS-integrated booking platform used by 140 GP practices

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer
bullets: Tech lead for the quote and pricing engine (Java, Kafka)
Mentored six engineers, three later promoted to senior

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built back-office tooling in C# and SQL Server for logistics clients
